description: This file contains integration tests for MQTT command and control functionalities in the Eclipse Hono project. It tests sending commands, handling responses, and failure cases through MQTT protocol, focusing on the CommandAndControlMqttIT class and related configurations.

classes.name: CommandAndControlMqttIT
classes.description: Integration test class for MQTT command and control in Eclipse Hono.

methods.name: allCombinations
methods.description: Provides a stream of different endpoint configurations for parameterized tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares test data and environment before each test.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates a message consumer with specified message handler.

methods.name: subscribeToCommands
methods.description: Subscribes to command topics with given configurations and handlers.

methods.name: testSendOneWayCommandSucceeds
methods.description: Tests successful sending of one-way commands via MQTT.

methods.name: testSendCommandSucceeds
methods.description: Generic method to test command forwarding with specified QoS.

methods.name: testSendCommandFailsForMalformedMessage
methods.description: Verifies that malformed command messages are rejected appropriately.
